findings.claim: The #266 issue itself (gh issue view 266) already states the scoping facts nearly verbatim to the task brief: no schema change, free-text wire, one shared vocabulary (eventTypeLabels.ts/eventTypeStyles.ts/locale keys), done-when items 1-7 covering unification, 4-locale keys (et fixed as 'Reis'/'Teenistus'), badge-treatment as an open design proposal bounded by the daylight six-hue cap (a PO-ruling constraint, not code-enforced — no assertion anywhere caps HUED_TYPES.length), picker ordering as open, #214/#247 pick-up-for-free verification, no migration, and lv/uk phone-width check.
findings.evidence: gh issue view 266 (mvox-dev/mvox-app), full body read this turn; app.css:21-40 shows the six hued tokens with a documented 4.5:1 contrast floor and 'Hue angle is Mihkel's to move' but no code assertion limiting the hued set to six.

risks: src/routes/event/[id]/page.spec.ts:672 (`expect(typeKeys.length).toBe(8)`) is a hard numeric literal that will fail the moment two locale keys are added in any of the four messages/*.json files — must be bumped to 10 (or better, derived) as part of GREEN.

src/routes/page.event-type-picker.spec.ts:201-210 hand-types its own CANONICAL_EVENT_TYPES array instead of importing the real one from $lib/events/eventTypeLabels — this is the parallel-list drift the issue explicitly asks to unify; if left as-is, GREEN must remember to manually add 'trip'/'service' to this test-local array too, or picker specs will silently stay stuck testing only 8 options while production offers 10.

src/lib/events/eventTypeLabels.spec.ts's vi.mock of paraglide messages (lines 21-30) only stubs the original 8 event_type_* keys — trip/service label lookups in that spec file will resolve through the real (unmocked in this file's scope) messages or produce an undefined-message case unless the mock is extended.

eventTypeStyles.spec.ts:90's exact-key-parity assertion means EVERY canonical type (including trip/service) must get an explicit entry in EVENT_TYPE_BADGE_CLASS — if GREEN forgets to add trip/service rows there while adding them to EVENT_TYPE_LABEL, this spec fails (a good guardrail, but a required touch point, not automatic).

No existing defensive truncation/max-width treatment exists on the badge/chip/picker text itself (only the event-name span and, on month view, the date column have explicit width/truncation handling) — if lv or uk translations for 'trip'/'service' exceed the current ~18-character ceiling set by 'Saviesīgs pasākums'/'Товариська зустріч', there is no existing wrap/truncate guard on badges specifically to fall back on; this should be visually checked on a narrow-phone viewport once translations are drafted.

The task brief's premise that '#250 size-step/outlined-pill mechanism', '#252 solid/outline arrange buttons', and 'et-caps interactions noted around #250/#251' bear on event-type handling could not be confirmed — both issues are about unrelated UI surfaces (day-header typography, roster indent controls). This may indicate the orchestrating brief conflated issue numbers/topics; findings for items (3) and part of (5) are reported as 'premise not found' rather than as confirmed facts.
